content:
Dan R: Heads up — preflight eval blocked the release for summarizer v3.2.3. DeployBot flagged a quality regression on the prompt suite.
Lina Q: Can you share the failing examples? is it a semantic flip or just length truncation? :thinking_face:
DeployBot: PREFLIGHT CHECK: summarizer/prompt-suite delta=+3.1% (threshold=+2.0%). Status: HOLD. Recommended action: triage <-> qa review or pin previous model.
Dan R: Most failures are longer-input truncation and hallucination on edge prompts. Only ~8/250 cases are clearly user-visible.
Michael I: Is this showing up only in the canary sample or the full sweep? region breakdown?
Dan R: Both regions sampled. Canary (1%) shows same delta but less frequent.
Ash: If it's rare and not safety-critical, we could still do a limited rollout in the next change window with stricter monitoring. But product needs signoff.
ReleaseLead Sam: Change window is +2 hours from now. We can either A) pin to v3.2.2 for all traffic, B) hold and roll back the candidate, or C) proceed with staged rollouts + guardrails. Need ops + pm decision.
Lina Q: Triage suggestion: run targeted token-level diffs on the 8 failing prompts and check impact on real traffic buckets. If false-positive, we can authorize a canary.
Dan R: Pasted two representative failures:
```
Input: long meeting transcript (~12k chars)
v3.2.2: Good high-level bullets
v3.2.3: added invented details + dropped key item
```
Lina Q: That's actionable — looks like a decoding/length heuristic change, not model-understanding noise.
Michael I: Ops note: if we proceed, I'll limit canary to 0.5% in us-west and 0% in eu while we watch latency and quality. Also add fallback routing to v3.2.2 on surge.
ReleaseLead Sam: PM signoff required: @Ash can you confirm product risk tolerance for a limited roll with manual rollback authority?
Ash: Product ok with limited roll only if rollback can be executed within 10m and we pin traffic >=50% back to v3.2.2 automatically on failure thresholds. :white_check_mark:
Dan R: I'll prepare rollout manifest and a bisect checklist. If any customer-facing regression >1% error-rate in 30m, we auto-rollback.
DeployBot: DEPLOY PLAN CREATED: canary 0.5% us-west, monitor summarizer/quality, auto-rollback threshold 1.0% regression over baseline. Action: awaiting /approve by ReleaseLead Sam.
ReleaseLead Sam: /approve — proceed with canary. Keep channel updated. If noise persists, we pin older model and open a postmortem.
Lina Q: I'll run the token-diff script against recent logs and post results in 15m.
Dan R: Thanks — starting rollout in 5m. If anyone sees slippage ping me directly. :pray:
DeployBot: DEPLOY STARTED: canary traffic routing to v3.2.3 at 0.5% (1732110076). Logs streaming to #observability.
